scripts.check: pnpm check:frontend && pnpm check:runtime && pnpm check:boundaries
scripts.check:runtime: uv run --project services/runtime --python 3.12 ruff check services/runtime/src tests && uv run --project services/runtime --python 3.12 pyright --pythonpath services/runtime/.venv/bin/python services/runtime/src
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --check --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo clippy --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings
scripts.test:runtime: PYTHONPATH=services/runtime/src uv run --project services/runtime --python 3.12 python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
scripts.build:runtime:check: python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; [compile(p.read_text(), str(p), "exec") for p in Path("services/runtime/src").rglob("*.py")]'
scripts.build:app: pnpm build:web && pnpm build:sidecar && pnpm --filter @mlx-studio/desktop tauri build
scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && uv sync --project services/runtime --frozen --extra mlx-vlm --extra mflux
